text:
# Pre-market brief, Wed 2026-11-04 (~8:25 AM ET)

1. **Midterms: Democrats win both chambers.** Futures first fell 1-2.5%, then flipped: by 6:02 ET S&P +1.1%, Nasdaq 100 +1.0%, Dow +1.6% ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-trump-media-ai-infrastructure-stocks-fall-amd-jumps-4998777)). Dollar at a one-month low, Treasuries and gold up ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/a-blue-wave-sends-futures-into-the-green.html)); 10-yr ~4.92%, 2-yr ~4.60% ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/nov/04/dollar-falls-while-gold-us-treasury-bonds-rally-markets-react-democrats-midterm-election-victory-marks-spencer-latest-live-updates)). Gold above $4,030 ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2117904690159505431)).
2. **Policy read-through:** solar up (FSLR ~+8%, RUN +8.6%); AI data-center names down on regulation/tax risk (CRWV -3.2%, NBIS -1.3%, ORCL -1.2%); DJT -7.4% ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-trump-media-ai-infrastructure-stocks-fall-amd-jumps-4998777)).
3. **AMD +7.3% pre:** Q3 rev $13.4B (+45%), Q4 guide ~$17B, 2027 growth >80% vs ~77% est.; $1B+ warrant charge ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/democrats-seize-congress-amd-shares-surge--whats-moving-markets-4997756)). SMCI +7% on big beat/raise; XYZ +5.9% on beat ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-trump-media-ai-infrastructure-stocks-fall-amd-jumps-4998777)). ANET ~+9.5% initial ([investingLive](https://investinglive.com/stocks/nasdaq-futures-slide-after-trump-s-midterm-setback-amd-and-arista-are-telling-a-different-story/)).
4. **Earnings losers:** DDOG -18% pre to $180 on a flat Q4 guide despite beat ([Public](https://public.com/stocks/ddog/pre-market); [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2117960688568328676)). UBER -2% on profit guide below est. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-trump-media-ai-infrastructure-stocks-fall-amd-jumps-4998777)).
5. **Earnings winners:** NVO +6.7% pre, beat and raised FY outlook ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/novo-q3-earnings-wegovy-sales.html); [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVO/)). CVS beat ($2.09 vs est.) and raised FY guide, yet -2.4% at 7:24 ([StockMarketWatch](https://stockmarketwatch.com/stock/CVS/premarket)).
6. **Oil/BTC:** Brent choppy, ~$101.85 at 10:34 GMT; Iran deal still far off ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/oil-us-midterm-election-results.html)). BTC dipped to ~$75.6k, back near $78.3k ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/11/04/bitcoin-rebounds-from-midterm-dip-as-defi-leads-gains)).
7. **Today:** ADP 8:15, ISM Services 10:00; after close QCOM, ARM, APP, MELI, EXPE, MET ([Bolsa al Día](https://bolsaaldia.com/en/us-market/stock-market-tomorrow-wednesday-november-4-2026-midterms-qualcomm-meli/)). Fri: October jobs.

## Swing ideas
- **CVS** long, low. Beat and FY raise, not a hot-theme name, and no gap to chase. Risk: managed-care policy risk under a Democratic Congress; pre-market weakness may continue.
- Watch for the close (gap >5%, our rule): NVO, XYZ. No AMD/SMCI chase; semis stay in avoid through 11/06.
